frames_after_trigger.policy: both cameras, every step from the trigger to the first open command after the move + 20 steps, then every 4th step and the last step; for C0 and for every arm that moved. An abstaining arm stores none: its trajectory equals C0 (checked), so its frames are those of C0

frames_after_trigger.why: abstained; trajectory equals the uninterrupted trunk (checked above)

frame_index.trunk: frame k = observation of step k, k = 0..trigger; trace row t = state after action t = observation of step t
frame_index.vision arm key <ARM>: frame j = observation of step trigger + j during the move (as in Phase B)

frames_layout: each frame is 128 x 256: base_camera left, hand_camera right; VISION_CENTER_V1 frames are hand_camera only
